title: NJ State Ethics Commission — Ali Houshmand — Decision — Dismissal (No. 017-13)
text:
IN THE MATTER OF STATE ETHICS COMMISSION
ALl HOUSHMAND,
PRESIDENT,
ROWAN UNIVERSITY Commission Case No. 17-13
DECISION
This matter arises from an allegation that Ali Houshrand, Rowan University President,
violated the Conflcts of Interest Law by circumventing the normal recruitment process to hire
friends into positions at the University, including Mira Lalovic-Hand, Kenneth Blank and
Anthony Lowman.
After considering the results of an investigation into the allegations against President
Houshrand, the Commission dismissed the matter pursuant to NJA.C 19:61-3.l(g).
DECISION RENDERED BY THE
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION ON
THE 16th DAY OF SEPTEMBER, 2014
